verdict.rationale: Clerk offers a first-party MCP server, CLI, and SKILL.md agent-skill file that let AI coding agents fetch snippets and run setup commands, giving some AI-native/agentic interaction surface. However, this is developer/setup tooling for integrating Clerk into an app, not evidence that end-users can operate Clerk's actual product features (auth, orgs, billing, permissions) via natural-language commands at runtime. Missing for 10: evidence of NL-driven end-user operation of core Clerk features (not just dev-time code generation), and any chat/agent interface for managing users/orgs/permissions conversationally.
